title: The Home page, next version — round 2, fourth look

steps.headline: The TV's arrow became a remote icon, lit while the remote is open, and the app buttons moved to the bottom of the remote.
steps.changed: Your two notes on the last look. The remote now reads top to bottom: arrows and OK, Back/Home/Play-pause, volume, then the apps.
steps.notice: Tapping the TV's name opens the remote too; the icon is the same press.
steps.risk: With the apps at the bottom, a short window may need a scroll to reach them.

steps.headline: A speaker playing from Spotify shows Spotify's mark and "on Spotify"; the soundbar playing the TV shows a TV.
steps.changed: Your note on Now playing. The mark comes from what Home Assistant reports the music is from: Spotify, YouTube Music, Apple Music, Amazon Music and Pandora are known.
steps.notice: When Home Assistant does not say where the music is from, the music note stays.
steps.risk: Some speakers never report a source, so the same song can show a mark on one speaker and a note on another.
